      "content_utf8": "import argparse, base64, gzip, hashlib, json, os, subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath\n\nBRANCH = 'feat/dapp-mobile-transport'\nARCHIVE_SHA256 = 'docs/transports/dapp-mobile-2026-10-25'\nWORKFLOW = '.github/workflows/static.yml'\n\ndef sha(data):\n    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()\n\ndef git(*args):\n    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], text=True).strip()\n\ndef main():\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument('--proof', required=True, type=Path)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    if os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY') != 'Neltud/xArtists':\n        raise RuntimeError('Wrong repository')\n    if os.environ.get('GITHUB_REF') != 'refs/heads/' + BRANCH:\n        raise RuntimeError('This importer is restricted to its completion branch')\n    if git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no'):\n        raise RuntimeError('Tracked source changes are already present')\n    root = Path.cwd().resolve()\n    transport = root / TRANSPORT\n    manifest = json.loads((transport / 'transport.json').read_text())\n    expected = {part['name'] for part in manifest['parts']} | {'transport.json', 'FILES.txt', 'restore.py'}\n    observed = {path.relative_to(transport).as_posix() for path in transport.rglob('*') if path.is_file()}\n    if observed != expected:\n        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected or missing transport files')\n    chunks = []\n    for part in manifest['parts']:\n        name = part['name']\n        if PurePosixPath(name).name != name:\n            raise RuntimeError('Unsafe part name')\n        data = (transport / name).read_bytes()\n        if sha(data) != part['sha256']:\n            raise RuntimeError('Truncated or altered part: ' + name)\n        chunks.append(data)\n    compressed = base64.b64decode(b''.join(chunks), validate=True)\n    if sha(compressed) != ARCHIVE_SHA256:\n        raise RuntimeError('Archive integrity failure')\n    payload = json.loads(gzip.decompress(compressed))\n    rows = payload['files']\n    targets = sorted((row['path'], row['sha256']) for row in rows)\n    if len(rows) != 26 or len(dict(targets)) != 26:\n        raise RuntimeError('Expected exactly 26 unique source paths')\n    if sha(json.dumps(targets, separators=(',', ':')).encode()) != TARGETS_SHA256:\n        raise RuntimeError('The source set differs from the reviewed kit')\n    subprocess.run(['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', payload['base_sha'], 'HEAD'], check=True)\n    plan = []\n    for row in rows:\n        name = row['path']\n        path = PurePosixPath(name)\n        if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or not (name.startswith('apps/frontend/') or name == WORKFLOW):\n            raise RuntimeError('Unsafe source path: ' + name)\n        target = root.joinpath(*path.parts)\n        target.resolve().relative_to(root)\n        if target.is_symlink():\n            raise RuntimeError('Symlink destination: ' + name)\n        blob = payload['blobs'][row['sha256']]\n        if blob['encoding'] == 'utf-8':\n            final = blob['data'].encode('utf-8')\n        elif blob['encoding'] == 'base64':\n            final = base64.b64decode(blob['data'], validate=True)\n        else:\n            raise RuntimeError('Unknown blob encoding')\n        if sha(final) != row['sha256']:\n            raise RuntimeError('Source integrity failure: ' + name)\n        before = sha(target.read_bytes()) if target.exists() else None\n        if name == WORKFLOW:\n            if before != row['sha256']:\n                raise RuntimeError('Upload the exact STATIC_WORKFLOW.yml through the API first')\n        elif before not in (row['before_sha256'], row['sha256']):\n            raise RuntimeError('Source drift; reconcile without overwriting: ' + name)\n        elif before != row['sha256']:\n            plan.append((target, final))\n    for target, final in plan:\n        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        target.write_bytes(final)\n    verified = []\n    for row in rows:\n        actual = sha((root / row['path']).read_bytes())\n        if actual != row['sha256']:\n            raise RuntimeError('Post-import verification failed: ' + row['path'])\n        verified.append({'path': row['path'], 'sha256': actual})\n    args.proof.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    args.proof.write_text(json.dumps({'verified_sources': 26, 'base_sha': payload['base_sha'], 'archive_sha256': ARCHIVE_SHA256, 'files': verified}, indent=2) + '\\n')\n    print('26/26 reviewed files SHA-256 OK; no workflow was changed by the runner.')\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n"

      "content_utf8": "name: Import complete verified dapp mobile sources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches: ['feat/dapp-mobile-transport']\n    paths: ['.github/workflows/import-dapp-mobile.yml']\n  workflow_dispatch:\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: dapp-mobile-completion\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\njobs:\n  import:\n    if: github.repository == 'Neltud/xArtists' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/feat/dapp-mobile-transport'\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    timeout-minutes: 25\n    permissions:\n      contents: write\n    env:\n      NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096\n      VITE_LIA_LIVE_TRADING: '0'\n      VITE_PAYBOX_ENABLED: 'false'\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: ${{ github.sha }}\n          fetch-depth: 0\n      - name: Restore exactly the reviewed files\n        run: python docs/transports/dapp-mobile-2026-10-25/restore.py --proof \"$RUNNER_TEMP/dapp-import-proof.json\"\n      - name: Commit candidate locally and remove transport files\n        run: |\n          git add --pathspec-from-file=docs/transports/dapp-mobile-2026-10-25/FILES.txt\n          if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -q '^.github/workflows/'; then\n            echo '::error::Workflow edits must be staged through the authorized API.'\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          git rm -r docs/transports/dapp-mobile-2026-10-25\n          git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'feat(dapp): complete verified mobile source import'\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4\n        with:\n          node-version: 20\n      - name: Install frontend dependencies\n        working-directory: apps/frontend\n        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps\n      - name: Verify frontend and mobile routes without transactions\n        working-directory: apps/frontend\n        run: |\n          npm run test:release\n          npm run check:routes\n          npm run render:check\n          node scripts/run-render-check.mjs modules\n          node scripts/run-render-check.mjs mobile\n      - name: Build and verify paper artifacts\n        working-directory: apps/frontend\n        run: |\n          npm run build\n          GITHUB_SHA=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\" node scripts/write-build-info.mjs\n          npm run verify:site\n          python -c 'import json; p=json.load(open(\"dist/dapp-release.json\")); assert p[\"lia_live_trading\"] is False; assert len(p[\"routes\"]) == 99'\n      - name: Publish only after passing checks, without force\n        run: |\n          git diff --exit-code\n          git fetch origin refs/heads/feat/dapp-mobile-transport\n          test \"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\" = \"$GITHUB_SHA\" || { echo 'Branch advanced; do not force-push.'; exit 1; }\n          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/feat/dapp-mobile-transport\n          HEAD_SHA=\"$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          REMOTE_SHA=\"$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/dapp-mobile-transport | cut -f1)\"\n          test \"$HEAD_SHA\" = \"$REMOTE_SHA\"\n          echo \"Complete source commit: $HEAD_SHA\" >> \"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY\"\n          echo '26 source hashes verified; frontend release, renders, routes and paper build passed.' >> \"$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY\"\n      - name: Preserve verification evidence\n        if: always()\n        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4\n        with:\n          name: dapp-mobile-import-proof\n          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dapp-import-proof.json\n"
    }
